watch.text: QB Carson Beck (back spasms) missed Week 11 and did not practice Wednesday; 40-year-old Josh Johnson started the 34-7 loss at Kansas City and is preparing to start again.
The Cardinals fired defensive coordinator Nick Rallis on Monday; Teryl Austin takes over on an interim basis.
QB Lamar Jackson (thumb surgery, IR) has a possible Week 16 return; Jacoby Brissett started Weeks 10-11, both losses, and the Ravens have lost six straight.
RB Derrick Henry went back into the concussion protocol Wednesday and was limited; the Ravens still expect him to play Houston.
CB Marlon Humphrey was a healthy scratch in the 35-33 loss at Carolina; the Ravens are noncommittal on him for Houston.
CB Christian Benford, TE Dalton Kincaid, G O'Cyrus Torrence, DL T.J. Sanders and LB Dorian Williams are all questionable for Kansas City on the final report.
G Brady Christensen (hamstring) reverted to season-ending injured reserve Tuesday when his practice window closed.
CB Kyler Gordon (shoulder, also missed Week 11) and S Elijah Hicks (concussion) are ruled out for Thanksgiving; CB Tyrique Stevenson is questionable.
TE Jake Ferguson, G Tyler Booker, WR Jonathan Mingo and S P.J. Locke are all ruled out for Thanksgiving; CB DaRon Bland is on IR.
S Jalen Thompson (hamstring) was activated off IR Wednesday after a full practice and is questionable vs. Philadelphia.
RB J.K. Dobbins is suspended for Friday at Pittsburgh, and DE Sai'vion Jones and S Taylor Rapp will not travel.
DE Aidan Hutchinson (ACL, season) and LB Jack Campbell are on IR and rookie DT Skyler Gill-Howard needs season-ending knee surgery; our ratings include games with them.
CB Ennis Rakestraw Jr. is ruled out for Thanksgiving; S Chuck Clark and edge DJ Wonnum are questionable.
CB D.J. Reed (hip), out the last three games, practiced fully Monday; S Kerby Joseph made his season debut in Week 11.
Edge Micah Parsons made his season debut in the 26-13 loss at the Rams (Nov. 25), playing 26 of 71 snaps with a sack; our ratings were built without him.
WR Christian Watson left the Rams game with a concussion in the second quarter; Green Bay managed two first downs after he went out.
RB Josh Jacobs (broken ring finger) did not play at the Rams, his second missed game in three; Kaleb Johnson led the backs with 8 carries.
LB Azeez Al-Shaair is on IR after groin surgery and DE Chris Braswell (knee, Nov. 19) is out for the season; DE Danielle Hunter is questionable.
The Colts released QB Daniel Jones after the 26-3 loss at Houston; Anthony Richardson Sr. makes his first start of the season.
OT Jalen Travis and CB Charvarius Ward did not practice Wednesday; OT Bernhard Raimann and CB Sauce Gardner, who also missed Week 11, practiced fully.
OT Walker Little (knee) left the 23-18 loss to the Giants, C Robert Hainsey is questionable and RT Anton Harrison is on IR.
RB Kenneth Walker III (groin) is ruled out at Buffalo, his third straight missed game, and OT Jaylon Moore (ankle) is out again.
G Trey Smith (concussion), who missed Week 11, was a full participant Monday.
DT Omarr Norman-Lott (knee) is out and DT Peter Woods (neck) and TE Noah Gray (ribs) are questionable at Buffalo on the final report.
WR Puka Nacua (MCL surgery) is out 4-5 months and WR Davante Adams (hamstring) is likelier back mid-December.
The Rams beat Green Bay 26-13 without G Steve Avila and C Coleman Shelton; TE Davis Allen hurt an ankle in the game and TE Terrance Ferguson needs season-ending surgery.
DT Kobie Turner (groin) returned from IR for the Green Bay game after full practices all week.
QB Justin Herbert, in the concussion protocol since the 27-24 loss to the Jets, did not practice Wednesday; DJ Uiagalelei is next up.
Rookie Fernando Mendoza has started Weeks 10-11 since Kirk Cousins was traded; most of our ratings were built with Cousins.
TE Brock Bowers (ankle/quad) missed Week 11 and is questionable for Sunday night at Cleveland.
QB Malik Willis (groin/core) is on IR; Kyle McCord started Weeks 10-11, including the 26-9 loss at Buffalo.
The defensive line has lost several players for the season, most recently DT Jordan Phillips (torn biceps).
QB Kyler Murray (hamstring) missed Weeks 9-11 and is questionable; Kirk Cousins, who started Weeks 10-11, stays the starter. WR Jordan Addison is not expected to play.
LT Christian Darrisaw hurt his right shoulder at San Francisco and did not return; the injury is not considered serious, per ESPN's Jeremy Fowler.
QB Drake Maye (fractured right fibula, Week 10) is out; Tommy DeVito stays QB1 per Mike Vrabel, but our ratings were built with Maye.
G Alijah Vera-Tucker (hamstring) was designated to return from IR Monday.
OL: OTs Asim Richards and Taliese Fuaga and C Erik McCoy, who all sat the last two games, were limited Wednesday; S Justin Reid was released.
CB Greg Newsome II (high ankle sprain) went on injured reserve Tuesday.
Edge Abdul Carter (ankle/calf) did not practice Wednesday.
RB Tyrone Tracy Jr. (hamstring, IR) could be reinstated when first eligible, ahead of the Week 13 game vs. San Francisco.
QB Geno Smith returned from his ankle injury for the 27-24 win at the Chargers; Cade Klubnik played much of the Week 10 loss to Buffalo.
Jalen Hurts is on IR; Tanner McKee started Weeks 7-8 and Joe Milton Weeks 9 and 11. Our ratings carry early-season games with Hurts.
Edge Arnold Ebiketie and CB Jonathan Jones are ruled out at Dallas and LB Zack Baun is on IR; CB Quinyon Mitchell practiced fully.
WR DeVonta Smith (hamstring) returned in the Week 11 win over Pittsburgh and practiced fully Monday.
The Steelers benched Aaron Rodgers Tuesday and waived him Wednesday after his McAfee Show interview; Mason Rudolph starts Friday vs. Denver.
LB Alex Highsmith (ankle) is expected to miss Friday vs. Denver, per ESPN's Jeremy Fowler; DT Cameron Heyward did not practice Wednesday and LB Nick Herbig (hip) was limited.
WR Michael Pittman Jr. (foot, IR) practiced fully Tuesday and is expected back vs. Denver after missing three games.
QB Sam Darnold, who missed Weeks 9-10 (Drew Lock started) before the bye, practiced fully Wednesday and is on track to start at San Francisco.
RT Abraham Lucas (ankle) and G Quenton Nelson (knee) are ruled out for Sunday at San Francisco.
QB Brock Purdy (low ankle sprain) did not practice Wednesday; Kyle Shanahan said there is a 'possibility' he misses Seattle, with Mac Jones next up.
RT Colton McKivitz fractured and dislocated his ankle vs. Minnesota and is likely out for the season; CB Deommodore Lenoir (foot) is still hurting.
CBs Benjamin Morrison (hamstring) and Jacob Parrish (back) had MRIs Monday; S Antoine Winfield Jr. is questionable.
QB Baker Mayfield is playing through plantar fasciitis and started the 31-21 loss at Detroit.
Three OL starters are on IR (Peter Skoronski, Jackson Slater, Fernando Carmona) and RB Tyjae Spears joined them.

reasons.text: Baltimore has lost six straight (4-7), the last two with Jacoby Brissett at QB while Lamar Jackson (thumb surgery, IR) is out until Week 16 at the earliest.
